purpose: Test one transport-only recovery for the immutable exec001 setup failure without changing lunar physics or opening a computational-precision result. Each secondary target is evaluated on a sparse two-wavelength source/output grid containing the target and the frozen AOD normalization wavelength 550 nm, with mc_spectral_is disabled.

triggerEvidence.rootCause: aerosol_set_tau_at_wvl 550 requires the internal wavelength interval to contain 550 nm; each failed input had only its secondary target wavelength

primaryDocumentation.requirement: The wavelength interval must contain the wavelength supplied to aerosol_set_tau_at_wvl.
primaryDocumentation.recoveryChoiceFrozenBeforeProbeResults: Keep aerosol_set_tau_at_wvl 550 0.10 unchanged and make the internal/source wavelength interval explicitly contain both the intended secondary target and 550 nm. Use a sparse source copied byte-value-for-byte from the already-frozen 1-nm ROLO source at those two nodes. Do not use mc_spectral_is. The 550-nm result is a technical anchor output and is excluded from compatibility acceptance and all later secondary precision evaluation except for structural presence/finite parsing.

sourceAndRuntime.sparseSourceRule: For each target, copy exactly the target-nm and 550-nm rows from the frozen full 380..780 nm 1-nm lunar source. No interpolation, renormalization, fitting, or distance scaling is introduced by the sparse technical source.

compatibilityAcceptance.interpretationIfPass: The exact runtime can execute the chosen AOD550-anchor mechanism and return a usable target mc_std. This does not establish secondary computational precision, TOA accuracy, empirical atmospheric moonlight accuracy, finite-disk accuracy, or production fitness.
compatibilityAcceptance.failureAction: Do not rerun this identity or choose a fallback based on radiance magnitude. Any alternative mechanism requires a new frozen result-blind contract and fresh probe seeds.
